title: Ester, no H - Sens*Hac
description: A boutique strategic interior design studio for retail, hospitality and wellness.

children.text: I’m Ester—without the “h” that almost everyone insists on adding—and I’ve spent half my life repeating the same phrase: “Ester, no H.”
What began as an anecdote became much more than a throwaway line over the years. It became a mark of identity.
That is why the name of my studio, sens*hac (“sense hac,” Catalan for “without an h”), is really a statement of intent.
From this commitment to authenticity comes the studio’s philosophy:
Every business has its own identity and a story worth telling. Our mission is to create spaces that tell it, express the essence of your brand, and connect with your customer.
Because a space that communicates and makes people feel something multiplies your brand’s value. That is our motto:

blocks.title: MY BACKGROUND
blocks.body:
Before graduating from La Massana, I studied geology between Barcelona and Norway. That period shaped my analytical outlook and ultimately strengthened and matured my creativity.

Sens*hac began after several years of collaborating with other designers. When my second child arrived, this life project truly began: the studio from which I help business owners with ideas and ambition bring their spaces to life and turn them into tools for sales and growth.

blocks.title: WHY WORK WITH SENS*HAC?
blocks.body: We stand out for our personal, one-to-one approach and our technical ability to create distinctive brand narratives that bring your essence into the space without diluting it. We do this by building a team of specialists around your project. Acting as a bridge between disciplines and partners, we provide one point of contact and ensure every design decision serves your business goals.

blocks.title: Have a business idea in mind?
blocks.body: Thinking of opening, renovating or giving your space a new lease of life? Tell me what you have in mind and let’s talk about how we can shape it.
